content_sections.heading: GAIL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
GAIL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for the GAIL Medical Consultant position is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which GAIL is recruiting?
faq.answer: GAIL is recruiting for the post of Medical Consultant – Part-Time Visiting Consultant MD (Medicine).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Medical Consultant position is ₹3,500/- per hour.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD with a Post Graduate Degree/MD (Medicine) from a recognized University/Institution and have valid registration with the Medical Council/National Medical Commission/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at GAIL Bhopal Zonal Office, 2nd Floor, 8, Maple High Street, Hoshangabad Road, in front of Aashima Mall, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant testimonials, updated Resume/CV, and two recent colour passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: This is a temporary job opportunity.
